# White Oak Dental

> White Oak Dental in Chaska, MN offers comprehensive family dentistry with advanced technology, led by Dr. April Korte.

White Oak Dental is a patient-focused dental practice in Chaska, Minnesota, providing general, cosmetic, restorative, and pediatric dentistry services. The practice emphasizes advanced technology including digital imaging, intraoral cameras, soft tissue lasers, and digital impression systems to deliver minimally invasive, high-quality care.

## Dental Services

- [Dental Services Chaska, MN | Sedation Dentistry | Cosmetic Dentist](https://www.chaskadentist.com/our-services.html): Complete overview of general, cosmetic, restorative, and sedation dentistry services.

- [Dental Checkups & Cleanings Chaska, MN | Prevent Cavities | White Oak Dental](https://www.chaskadentist.com/dental-checkups-and-cleanings.html): Dental checkups and cleanings with ultrasonic scalers to prevent cavities.
- [Restorative Dentistry Chaska, MN | Dental Crowns | Dentures](https://www.chaskadentist.com/restorative-dentistry.html): Restorative services including dental crowns, dentures, and tooth-colored fillings.
- [Gum Disease Treatment Chaska, MN | Scaling and Root Planing | White Oak Dental](https://www.chaskadentist.com/periodontal-therapy.html): Gum disease treatment using scaling, root planing, and Picasso Lite laser therapy.
- [Children's Dentist Chaska, MN | Kids' Dental Visits | Cavity Prevention](https://www.chaskadentist.com/childrens-dentistry.html): Pediatric dental care and cavity prevention services for children in Chaska.
- [Replace Missing Teeth Chaska, MN | Dental Bridges | Dentures](https://www.chaskadentist.com/replace-missing-teeth.html): Missing teeth solutions including dental bridges, dentures, and implants.
